V1__init.sql: Creates customers, products, orders and order items, plus the legacy coupons and tags tables.
V2__customer_phone.sql: Adds a phone column to customers, with an index.
V3__rename_order_status.sql: Renames orders.status to state (confirmed) and widens it to 30 characters.
V4__product_sku.sql: Adds a NOT NULL, UNIQUE sku to products and widens the price precision. Adding sku fails if products already has rows.
V5__shipments.sql: Adds a shipment status enum and a shipments table that references orders.
V6__order_summary_view.sql: Adds a view of order count and amount per customer.
V7__drop_legacy.sql: Drops the whole legacy coupons table and the customers.fax and orders.memo columns. Their data is lost.
V8__recreate_tags.sql: Drops and recreates the tags table with a longer label and a color. All existing tag rows are lost.
V9__catalog_and_inventory.sql: Adds product categories, supplier catalogs and multi-warehouse inventory with a low-stock index.
V10__customer_operations.sql: Adds customer addresses, payment records, product returns, returned line items and an order status event log.
